proof_nl: Let m = floor(nr). By the definition of the floor function, m is an integer satisfying m <= nr < m + 1. Since n > 1, we have n > 0, so dividing the inequality by the positive number n preserves the inequality signs. Therefore m/n <= r < (m + 1)/n. This is exactly the desired statement.
